text: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field. But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
translation: 进步主义者往往将强制多元化指令（diversity mandates）视作通往平等的康庄大道以及拉平竞争跑道的一种手段；然而在太多情况下，此类政策不过是一种虚伪不诚的“道德标榜”（virtue-signaling），它仅仅让极少数处于最顶层的特权女性坐享其成，对帮助普通大众几乎毫无裨益（does little to help / help little）。

text: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
translation: 由马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯与众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德联合发起的两项旨在确保董事会与委员会“性别均等”的法案，便是一个极其典型的例证。

text: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female. In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas. If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
translation: 哈达德与刘易斯深感忧虑的是，全州超过半数的政府委员会中女性比例不足40%。为了确保精英阶层女性（elite women）能够获得更多此类机会，他们提议推行政府硬性配额指令；若该法案最终成为法律，到2022年各州级委员会将被强制预留50%的董事席位给女性。

text: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies. In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
translation: 这些法案与加利福尼亚州近期通过的一项举措高度相似——加州去年成为全美首个对私营私有企业强制推行性别配额的州。在签署该法案时，加州州长杰里·布朗亦公开承认：这项明确基于性别划分人群的法律，很可能是违宪的（probably unconstitutional / may go against Constitution）。

text: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest. Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
translation: 美国最高法院历来对基于性别的分类标准深表不以为然，除非该标准旨在解决某种极其“重大”的公共政策利益。鉴于加州法律无差别地适用于所有私企董事会（即使某些企业过往根本不存在任何歧视历史），法院极可能会最终裁决该法律违反了宪法所赋予的“平等保护”（equal protection）保障条款。

text: But are such government mandates even necessary? Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
translation: 然而，此类政府行政强制指令真的有哪怕一点点必要吗？女性在企业董事会中的任职比例在当前或许尚未完美对应女性在总人口中的占比，但那又如何呢？

text: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference. According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
translation: 在完全没有任何政府行政干预的前提下，企业董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步健康攀升。根据 Catalyst 咨询机构开展的一项权威研究，在2010年至2015年期间，全球跨国企业董事会中的女性比例大幅猛增了54%之多（needlessness of government interventions）。

text: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards. That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
translation: 强制要求企业将性别视作董事资格的首要考量标准，必将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会的整体资历与专业经验大幅下滑——这恰恰正是挪威在全国范围内推行私企性别配额时所真实上演的惨痛一幕（entry of unqualified candidates / less experienced）。

text: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
translation: 爱丽丝·李在《新共和》撰文指出：在并未切实扩大能够胜任董事职责的合格女性人才储备池的前提下，盲目拔高董事席位数量，直接导致了极其荒唐的“金裙现象”（golden skirt）——即极少数相同的顶层精英女性在各大不同公司董事会中四处狂揽身兼多个席位。

text: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
translation: 下一次再有人打着促进性别平等的旗号兜售企业硬性配额时，请务必清醒牢记：此类政策在极大程度上不过是政客们自我谋私的自利手段，除了让法案发起人自我感动感觉良好之外，对切实帮助千千万万普通女性根本起不到任何实质作用（Feasibility should be a prime concern）。
